observation: A visual-status flag could populate source-review status, and component presence plus stroke checks could miss exported coordinate defects even when the canonical model remained correct.
cause: Review state was coupled to presentation approval, while vector validation did not compare ordered exported component coordinates to solved model contours.
proposed_rule: Keep source review in a separate evidence-and-hash-bound record that visual status cannot promote; validate exported physical coordinates, contour coverage, junctions, colour, and line style, including export-only fault injection with an unchanged correct model.
verification_scope: A200 Kitchens 4, 3, and 1 validator behavior plus skill instruction review; no claim of general performance on a different customer drawing.
